## REQ-CMP-008

**Resource interaction patterns via the Method element**

From Level 2 on, a component supports the resource interaction patterns of the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set where applicable, and publishing resources via Pub (MG 7.1.4, MG 9.1). The methods per entity type are detailed by REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-016.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 7.1.4, MG 9.1
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG 7.2
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-eccafa9f

> Resource interaction patterns via the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set (where applicable) and publishing resources via Pub (7.1.4 Method Element, 9.1 Resources) - Mandatory Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

**Complete MQTT client behavior**

> — MG 1.3

## REQ-CMP-010

**Complete Message Bus behavior**

Every method, resource and common service a component offers conforms completely to MG 9 (Message Bus communication), and the component supports the methods and resources required by REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-023. Methods, resources and services not listed there (e.g. Del, Call/Reply, SubscriptionList, Config, Data, NewDataSetWriterId) are optional; if offered, they are covered by this requirement.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 7.2, MG 9
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG 7.2, SF-037
- Verification: d7-test, d7-monitor
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-2754fc26, MG-1.3-7b6455c5, MG-7.2-0c2efb06, MG-7.2-9e0478b4

> Complete Message Bus behavior, e.g. the resources Profile, PublicationList, SubscriptionList, Metadata, ReferenceDesignation and Event (7.2 Minimum Set of Topic Elements for Open Industry 4.0 Alliance Compliance, 9 Message Bus Communication) - Recommended Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

> Level 3 (Full): The entity supports the complete set of mandatory methods and resources defined in the following sub-chapters.
> — MG 7.2

Notes: Interpretation of SF-037 (a, b): the MG 1.3 "e.g." list is broader than the minimum sets of MG 7.2.1/7.2.2; the minimum sets are taken as authoritative until the PO decides.

- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST

## REQ-CMP-025

**Field presence follows the Requirement attribute**

In every payload object, a field whose attribute Requirement is Mandatory is present, and a field whose Requirement is Not used is absent. A field marked Optional may be present.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 1.2
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.2-5d607928

> The attribute Requirement of a field: Mandatory means the field must be present, Optional means the field may be present and Not used means the field must not be present.
> — MG 1.2

## REQ-CMP-026

**Present fields meet Type and Value Range**

Every field present in a payload object meets the format definitions of the field (Type and Value Range), regardless of whether the field is mandatory or optional.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher

- Verification: schema, d7-validate
